external_figures.name: Hudson Leick
external_figures.note: The American actress who played Callisto in Xena: Warrior Princess, born Heidi Hudson Leick (verified 2026-08-24). Facts only. She is held here for an etymology rather than a portrayal: GDWA's own Heidi Leick is an original character of that all-women fed, and the fed banned real wrestlers from its roster outright, so nothing of this actress is staged. What the name records is the borrowing itself — the character leans on the actress's TRUE given name rather than the stage name she was billed under, which is a deliberate and unusually well-informed piece of naming for a 1990s women's wrestling e-fed whose own register was warrior women.
